page.title: Import from a spreadsheet
page.description: Bring in the samples you already recorded in Excel or a CSV file. Nothing is saved until you confirm the preview.

upload.title: Choose a file
upload.description: An Excel (.xlsx, .xls) or CSV file, up to 10 MB and 5,000 rows. One sheet is imported at a time. The file is read in your browser and never uploaded.

errors.unsupportedType: This file type is not supported. Use .xlsx, .xls or .csv.
errors.tooLarge: This file is larger than 10 MB.
errors.tooManyRows: A sheet has more than 5,000 rows. Split it and import the parts one by one.
errors.unreadable: This file could not be read. Is it damaged or password protected?
errors.noRows: This sheet has no rows to import.
errors.changed: The project changed since the preview. Check the updated preview and try again.

layout.title: Find the table
layout.description: Tell the import where the column headers are.
layout.headerRowHint: The row number as the spreadsheet shows it. A title line above the table is skipped.
layout.unitsLabel: The row under the headers holds units
layout.unitsHint: For example W, nm or °C. Otherwise a unit written in a header, like “Power (W)”, is used.
layout.headerRowInvalid: Enter a row number that exists in this sheet.

target.title: Where do the samples go?
target.description: Each sheet becomes one experiment, or adds rows to an existing one.
target.prefixHint: 2 to 6 letters or digits, starting with a letter, e.g. ALD.
target.noExperiments: This project has no experiments yet. Create a new one.

mapping.title: Match the columns
mapping.description: Choose what each column of your sheet becomes. Check the examples on the right.

dateFormat.label: Dates in your sheet are written as

preview.title: Check before importing
preview.description: Nothing is saved yet. Fix what is flagged, or choose what to do with it.

counts.new: {count, plural, one {# new sample} other {# new samples}}
counts.conflict: {count, plural, one {# code already exists} other {# codes already exist}}
counts.error: {count, plural, one {# row with a problem} other {# rows with problems}}
counts.empty: {count, plural, one {# empty row ignored} other {# empty rows ignored}}

preview.nothingToReview: Every row is new and valid.

choice.addAsNew: Add as new with another code
choice.changes: {count, plural, one {# value changes} other {# values change}}

preview.cannotImport: Fix the problems above, or skip the rows that have them, to import.

issues.codeTooLong: The code is too long (40 characters at most).
issues.codeDuplicate: This code already exists in the project.
issues.dateInvalid: This is not a real date in the chosen format.
issues.valueNotANumber: Enter a number. Text is not accepted in a number column.
issues.noteTooLong: The note, with the cell comments added, is over 500 characters.
issues.duplicateInFile: This code appears more than once in the file.
issues.updateNotAllowed: This code belongs to another experiment, so it cannot be updated here.
issues.studyNameInvalid: A study name is empty or too long.
issues.codeNotMapped: Choose which column holds the sample code.
issues.targetUsedTwice: Each field, and each existing column, can only be used once.
issues.unknownColumn: A chosen column no longer exists in this experiment.
issues.nameDuplicate: Another column already has this name.
issues.unitTooLong: The unit is too long (20 characters at most).
issues.codePrefixInvalid: Use 2 to 6 letters or digits, starting with a letter.
issues.codePrefixDuplicate: Another experiment in this project already uses this prefix.

done.title: Import finished
done.summary: {created, plural, one {# sample added} other {# samples added}}, {updated} updated, {skipped} skipped.
done.reminder: Until the database is connected, imported data lives in memory and is lost when the server restarts.
